# VFX UI Anime

> Dependency-free anime-inspired Web Components for expressive interface feedback.

## Project map
- `README.md`: overview and quick start.
- `core.js`: shared canvas and motion engine.
- `components/button.js`: vfx-button.
- `components/toggle.js`: vfx-toggle.
- `components/slider.js`: vfx-slider.
- `components/checkbox.js`: vfx-checkbox.
- `components/radio.js`: vfx-radio.
- `components/input.js`: vfx-input.
- `components/tabs.js`: vfx-tabs.
- `components/progress.js`: vfx-progress.
- `components/rating.js`: vfx-rating.
- `components/toast.js`: vfx-toast.
- `components/tooltip.js`: vfx-tooltip.
- `docs/COMPONENTS.md`: public attributes, properties, methods and events.
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`: runtime architecture.
- `docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md`: known accessibility gaps and QA checklist.
- `skills/vfx-ui-anime/SKILL.md`: instructions for extending the project.

## Integration rules
1. Load `core.js` before component scripts.
2. Keep native semantics and keyboard behavior.
3. Use the documented custom element names and events.
4. Do not claim full accessibility or cross-browser support without testing.
5. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
6. Preserve the project's MIT license when redistributing.
